book.frozen_dominion.chronicle_i.p1:
§lChronicle of the Thaw§r
§oPart One: The Approach§r

We are the third expedition. The first two are still out there somewhere under the drifts, and we have stopped pretending we will find them.
book.frozen_dominion.chronicle_i.p2:
The snow here does not fall. It waits.

Sixteen days north of the last village the weather simply stopped changing - no wind, no thaw, no night that was any colder than the day. Brannoc called it the still country. The name stuck.
book.frozen_dominion.chronicle_i.p3:
On the twenty-second day we saw it.

A wall of blue glass the height of forty men, and above it towers like knives held point-up. Nothing that cold should be able to stand. It has stood a thousand years.
book.frozen_dominion.chronicle_i.p4:
There is one way in. We walked the whole circumference twice to be sure of it. One gate, and a stair that has been swept clean by something that is still in there sweeping.

Rhoswen wanted to turn back at the gate. I wish I had listened.
book.frozen_dominion.chronicle_i.p5:
§oOn the garrison§r

They do not breathe and they do not rot. Cut one open and there is no blood, only a splinter of pale ice where a heart should sit.

We have started collecting them. They are worth more than anything else we will carry home.
book.frozen_dominion.chronicle_i.p6:
They do not hunt us. That is the part nobody writes down properly.

They are standing guard. After a thousand years with nothing to guard against, they are still at their posts, waiting to be dismissed by a king who cannot speak.

§o- continued in Part Two§r
book.frozen_dominion.chronicle_ii.p1:
§lChronicle of the Thaw§r
§oPart Two: What We Learned§r

I am writing this in the watchtower because I will not write it inside those walls. Some things should not be put on paper within earshot.
book.frozen_dominion.chronicle_ii.p2:
His name was Velkhar and he was a man, once. That is the whole horror of it.

The crown was not a gift. It was a sentence. They put it on him so that the winter would have somewhere to live that was not the world, and he agreed to it.
book.frozen_dominion.chronicle_ii.p3:
§oOn the Stormcrown§r

There is a beacon on the roof. While it burns, every dead thing in the citadel hits harder and heals faster, and the air itself refuses to let you dig - and even put out, it holds the stone for as long as the king lives.

It cannot be mined. We tried for two days and blunted every pick we had.
book.frozen_dominion.chronicle_ii.p4:
So Brannoc forged a wedge for it. One job, one swing, and then the roof belongs to us again.

He never got to use it. It is in the tower with this book. Whoever finds both - take the wedge first.
book.frozen_dominion.chronicle_ii.p5:
§oOn the throne§r

The cathedral below the citadel is sealed, and it is not sealed with a door. The ice there answers to one thing only: a sigil, and the sigil is held by the warden of the vault.

Kill the warden. Take the key. Nothing else opens it - we tried digging and the walls healed behind us.
book.frozen_dominion.chronicle_ii.p6:
§oLast entry§r

We are going down tomorrow. Four of us left.

If you are reading this, you got further than we did, and you already know what waits on the throne. He has been holding a thousand winters on his own shoulders and he is very, very tired.

Do him the kindness. Finish it.

item.frozen_dominion.rune_prisons.desc: The guards never trusted the bars they locked on others. They kept their hoard behind the wall they slept by - the stone beside it worn smooth by their fingers.
item.frozen_dominion.rune_crypts.desc: The Mausoleum holds one more tomb than it shows. The court's last mourner knows which wall it was cut behind.
item.frozen_dominion.rune_storm.desc: The storm's priests prayed to the lightning, yet hid their secrets from it - in the quiet behind the sanctuary's wall, far from the coils.
item.frozen_dominion.rune_depths.desc: The deep gave back one thing: a sign worn into the Ossuary's wall, where the dead were laid before the Chasm of Bones.
item.frozen_dominion.cell_key.desc: It hung in the armoury, where the guards kept the keys of the cells. Opens the Cell Grate.
item.frozen_dominion.court_key.desc: Carried by the Shade Shepherd of the crypts' ritual chamber. Opens the Court Gate - the way down to the Frozen Court.
item.frozen_dominion.chamber_key.desc: The Drowned Lady wore it at the last dance. Opens the Chamber Door.
item.frozen_dominion.archive_key.desc: Dropped by the Rime Priestess. Opens the Archive Gate.
item.frozen_dominion.storm_key.desc: Kept beside the statue in the hall beyond the Archive. Opens the Storm Gate, the way down to the beacon.

journal.frozen_dominion.chill: §7§o[Journal] This frost is not weather. It comes off the light on the citadel's roof and goes through every fur. The expedition left its last fire sealed in brass, back at the camp - if I had it, the cold would not reach me.
message.frozen_dominion.arena_no_build: Nothing can be built in this arena
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f1.p1:
THE FIRST WINTER

He came down the steps with the shield before him like a wall of the citadel itself, and our first rank broke on it.

- Hallevin
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f1.p2:
Nothing we threw at his face went home. The shield turns everything and the blade comes after it, slow, sure.

But a wall has one side.
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f1.p3:
Brannoc went round him while he cut at the others and struck him in the back, and the King staggered - the only time we saw him stagger.

Never stand where he is looking.
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f2.p1:
THE STORM COURT

When the shield cracked he did not fall. He called the storm into the hall and the hall answered.

- Hallevin
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f2.p2:
The air itself turned on us: ice from nowhere, the floor breaking under our feet, the wind throwing men into the walls.

He was everywhere and nowhere.
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f2.p3: What I learnt too late: the storm is his, but it is not him. It gathers before it strikes. Watch where it gathers, and be elsewhere.
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f25.p1:
THE TWIN EDGES

Then two blades, one in each hand, and a speed no king in armour should have.

- Hallevin
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f25.p2:
He dances. A cut, a cut, a turn - and the third cut always comes from the side you are not guarding.

Count them.
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f25.p3: He tires after the dance, for a breath. One breath. I saw Edric use it and I saw Edric die a breath later. Use it - and step back.
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f3.p1:
THE HOLLOW CROWN

At the last he was not a man. The armour hung on nothing and the crown floated over it in a ring of cold light.

- Hallevin
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f3.p2: The staff in the halo is the heart of him now. Every spell he casts comes through it, and the light in the crown dims when it has spent.
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f3.p3:
I do not know how he is killed. I only know he did not finish us: we ran. If you read this, you did not.

Go carefully, and go quickly.
entity.frozen_dominion.lamplighter.shade: In the shadow - he is open

book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f1.p4:
COUNSEL - THE FIRST PHASE

His shield guards his front and turns every blow. Go round him and strike his back: there his armour does not hold.
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f2.p4:
COUNSEL - THE SECOND PHASE

Dodge. Every blow of his can be outwaited - do not take them on yourself, roll aside and come back in after.
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f25.p4:
COUNSEL - THE THIRD PHASE

Raise your shield. Take the tower's hail and the twin blades on a shield, never on your body.
book.frozen_dominion.velkhar_f3.p4:
COUNSEL - THE FOURTH PHASE

(written in another hand)

He takes you up above the clouds. Keep to the ice. Take up a bow: break the storm anchors - while they stand he flies and nothing of yours reaches him. Then he falls: strike.
book.frozen_dominion.camp_log.p1:
THE CAMP LOG

Day 9. Camp made a day short of the tower. The dogs will not settle - they stand at the palisade all night and whine at the snow.
book.frozen_dominion.camp_log.p2: Day 11. Two of the watch went out to the woodline for logs and did not come back. Their tracks went into a drift and did not come out the other side. We built the palisade higher.
book.frozen_dominion.camp_log.p3: Day 12. The drifts move. We watched one from the lookout until dark: at noon it lay by the east tent, at dusk by the fire. Keep the lanterns lit. Do not sleep near the snow banks.
book.frozen_dominion.camp_log.p4:
Day 13. Hallevin has gone on to the watchtower. A copy of his map and our last ember, sealed in brass, are in the chest in the first tent - whoever reads this, take them. We wait for the thaw.

- Maren

enchantment.frozen_dominion.kings_echo.d: Where the arrow strikes, a spike of ice comes up out of the floor a second later.
message.frozen_dominion.monstrosity_tame: The ice breaks. The Monstrosity rises - and it heeds you.
message.frozen_dominion.monstrosity_sadd: The saddle is set on the Monstrosity's back.
BEYOND THE GATE

It was not born. It was made - of the ice the king laid in his own floors: it glows, and lifts out in a bare hand.

And of a heart that is always the middle of winter. What was made once can be made again.
Blackstone, ice like a man, its skull. The heart into the skull.
The ice breaks. What climbs out obeys the hand that woke it.

THE HEART

The king carries it in him, and it falls with him.

Eat it, and the cold will never find you again. But then there is nothing left to wake what sleeps.

Choose before you are hungry.
message.frozen_dominion.monstrosity_plin: The statue has to stand on a block of blackstone.
message.frozen_dominion.monstrosity_skul: The statue needs a head: the Monstrosity's skull.
book.frozen_dominion.kronika.name: Chronicle of the Citadel
book.frozen_dominion.kronika.subtitle: written from what three expeditions left behind
book.frozen_dominion.kronika.landing: All that is known of the Hollow King's citadel - and only what you have already seen opens. Begin with $(l)The Expedition$().
item.frozen_dominion.throne_bane.passive: Every hit feeds the Aurochs' Wrath. At 10 the blade blazes for 8 s:
each swing throws an ice crescent, skills grow stronger, one Throne-slayer is free
item.frozen_dominion.throne_bane.use.cha: Tap RMB - Charge: a dash behind a spectral bull that stuns
item.frozen_dominion.throne_bane.use.ham: Sneak + RMB - Overseer's Hammer: leap and slam, frozen foes take double
item.frozen_dominion.throne_bane.use.plu: RMB in the air - Fall of the Crown: the higher the fall, the harder
item.frozen_dominion.throne_bane.use.sla: Hold RMB 2 s, release - Throne-slayer: a crescent through armour
item.frozen_dominion.throne_bane.combo: Charge into Hammer doubles its rings; Throne-slayer breaks the stunned
item.frozen_dominion.throne_bane.lore: The throne's executioner, forged from horn and hammer.
item.frozen_dominion.throne_bane.combo_r: Charge into Hammer: the rings doubled!
Hold use: Litany - up to 5 runes gather round you; let go and they fly at your target. Each one frostbites it and marks it
Tap use: Bell of Penance - a spectral bell falls where you look; its toll knocks the marked down (9 s)
Sneak + use: Black Tide - black water rushes out from you, then drags all it caught back; the marked are held fast (12 s)
Every %s casts: Requiem - 8 s of hovering, cooldowns halved, the Litany twice as fast
The marked who die rise as your shades for 10 s
The Bell strikes half again as hard on those the Tide holds; runes under the Bell's shadow split in two
The Hollow King's own staff, made whole again from what his court left behind.
tooltip.frozen_dominion.temper.fang: Tempered with a Frostmaw's Fang: +1.5 damage, one blow in four frostbites
tooltip.frozen_dominion.temper.rivet: Tempered with a Sentinel's Rivet: +2 armour, less knockback
tooltip.frozen_dominion.temper.fletching: Tempered with Stillbow Fletching: arrows strike 20% harder
tooltip.frozen_dominion.temper.prism: Tempered with a Rimeweaver's Prism: +1 armour toughness, ice power
tooltip.frozen_dominion.temper.attuned: Tempered with an Attuned Prism: +1 heart
tooltip.frozen_dominion.temper.core: Tempered with a Warden's Core: +1.5 toughness, less knockback
item.frozen_dominion.kingsrime_sword.shi: Hold Shift to see the sword's skills
item.frozen_dominion.kingsrime_sword.ski: A crescent of frost flies 9 blocks, cutting through every foe in its path
Blink 6 blocks through your foes, untouchable as you pass; the ice blades left hanging behind you burst half a second later
Plant the blade: a crown of ice rises around you and bursts outward, freezing foes within 5 blocks in place
Hits on Frostbitten foes build up to 5 stacks (the item's bar); at 5 your next Rime Crescent flies as three
item.frozen_dominion.kingsrime_sword.com: Royal Step through a foe, then Rime Crescent within a second: the crescent doubles in size
item.frozen_dominion.kingsrime_sword.shi: With a shield in the off hand the use key blocks; Rime Crescent and Coronation need a free hand
item.frozen_dominion.last_watch_bow.desc: Full draw: Lantern Beam - pierces everything for 30 blocks and marks it
An arrow into a marked foe: chains hold every marked foe (2 s)
Sneak + use: The Last Watch - leap back, an ice watchman stands guard (15 s)
Use in the air: Rain - five arrows renew the marks (4 s)
Vigil: hits in a row; at five the beam splits in three
item.frozen_dominion.last_watch_bow.vigi: Vigil full - the next beam splits!
item.frozen_dominion.last_watch_bow.lore: The lantern's lens, the keeper's chain - the last watch never sleeps
item.frozen_dominion.bone_wand.summon: Use: Call of the Grave - a grave's ring opens where you look and two Frost Skeletons claw their way out to serve you for 40 s (12 s)
item.frozen_dominion.bone_wand.command: Sneak + use: Command - your servants charge the foe you point at, half again as fast for 5 s, leaping at it first (6 s)
item.frozen_dominion.bone_wand.servants: At most %s servants: a new one sends the oldest to dust. Beaten, a servant falls apart and gets up once more
item.frozen_dominion.bone_wand.lore: The smith's iron skull, an Everfrost shaft, the vertebrae of the dead for a grip. The citadel's dead still answer it.
item.frozen_dominion.frost_vertebra.desc: A vertebra off a Frost Skeleton's back, still cold. On the Frost Anvil, with the smith's Wand Fitting and an Everfrost Ingot, it makes a wand that calls up the dead.
msg.frozen_dominion.bone_wand.nowhere: There is no floor there to call them up from
msg.frozen_dominion.bone_wand.no_servant: You have no servants to command
msg.frozen_dominion.bone_wand.no_target: There is no one there to send them at
entity.frozen_dominion.velkhar.storm_eye: Velkhar: §oThis is the eye of my storm. Nothing that falls from it comes back.§r
entity.frozen_dominion.velkhar.storm_anc: §oStorm anchors rise on the outer floes - while they stand, he flies and nothing reaches him.§r
entity.frozen_dominion.velkhar.storm_fal: §oThe anchors are broken - he falls! Strike now!§r
entity.frozen_dominion.velkhar.storm_clo: Velkhar: §oThe eye is closing. When it shuts, the winter takes everything.§r
message.frozen_dominion.storm_eye_no_fli: The storm tears the wings from your back
message.frozen_dominion.storm_eye_no_esc: The storm does not let you go
message.frozen_dominion.storm_eye_no_bui: Nothing can be built in the eye of the storm
message.frozen_dominion.storm_eye_spared: The storm throws you back. It will not do it again for nothing - only for a Gale Feather.
death.attack.frozen_dominion.storm_eye: %1$s was swallowed by the eye of the storm
death.attack.frozen_dominion.storm_eye.p: %1$s was swallowed by the eye of the storm fighting %2$s
subtitles.frozen_dominion.storm_eye_asce: The storm tears the hall open
subtitles.frozen_dominion.storm_eye_clos: The eye of the storm closes
message.frozen_dominion.storm_eye_seized: Velkhar seizes you - the storm takes you up!
velkhar.line.preserve: May the frost preserve your corpse.
velkhar.line.fortress: This citadel has stood for centuries. You will not be the one to claim it.
velkhar.line.gate: You have crossed the final gate.
velkhar.line.glory: You seek glory? You shall find only death.
entity.frozen_dominion.forge_overseer.se: The Overseer heads for a trough of water...
entity.frozen_dominion.forge_overseer.de: His water is gone - the Overseer bellows and reels
subtitles.frozen_dominion.whiteout_rush: A blade scrapes the ice, armour charges
message.frozen_dominion.whiteout_illusio: An illusion! The storm bites back.
message.frozen_dominion.whiteout_stumble: Caught on his run - Velkhar stumbles!
message.frozen_dominion.anchor_shield: The Storm Anchors shield him - break them!
message.frozen_dominion.shrine_kindled: The Frost Shrine burns. When you fall, you will rise here.
message.frozen_dominion.shrine_kept: You will rise at the Frost Shrine before the hall's door, with everything you carried. Only your experience is lost.
message.frozen_dominion.shrine_kept_thro: You will rise at the Frost Shrine before the throne hall, with everything you carried. Only your experience is lost.
message.frozen_dominion.shrine_floor: What you carried fell to the floor of the throne hall, at the foot of the wind's column.
message.frozen_dominion.shrine_returned: The shrine gives back all you carried.
cutscene.frozen_dominion.bone_lord.epita: It ran after everyone. In the end it only fell.
cutscene.frozen_dominion.ice_monstrosity: The ice it was made of went back to the cold.
item.frozen_dominion.chase_femur.desc1: What it strikes may go down - more surely when you are running.
item.frozen_dominion.chase_femur.desc2: The Bone Lord's thighbone, shod in everfrost by Velkhar's smith.
Worn as a charm: the frost in a keeper's doorway thins, the citadel's haze draws back.
The stub he lit the great lantern with. It still burns cold.
entity.frozen_dominion.lamplighter.hand: His own lantern is open - keep clear of its light
message.frozen_dominion.citadel_no_build: The citadel suffers no building - only a Frost Anvil may be set down here.
message.frozen_dominion.shrine_kept_belo: You will rise at the Frost Shrine at the foot of the descent, with everything you carried. Only your experience is lost.
message.frozen_dominion.shrine_wait: What you carried waits in the Frost Shrine before the hall's door. Lay a hand on it to take it back. Only your experience is lost.
message.frozen_dominion.shrine_kept_own: You will rise at your Frost Shrine, with everything you carried. Only your experience is lost.
message.frozen_dominion.shrine_wait_belo: What you carried waits in the Frost Shrine at the foot of the descent. Lay a hand on it to take it back. Only your experience is lost.
message.frozen_dominion.shrine_wait_thro: What you carried waits in the Frost Shrine before the Throne Room. Lay a hand on it to take it back. Only your experience is lost.
item.frozen_dominion.gale_feather.desc: §9In the Eye of the Storm, each fall after the first eats one and the gust throws you back up
item.frozen_dominion.gale_feather.desc2: §7Each saved fall costs half your health. Lose the fight and those eaten come back with your things
message.frozen_dominion.storm_eye_spared: A Gale Feather bears you back up and crumbles into frost. Left: %s
item.frozen_dominion.warmth_potion.desc: The expedition's fire sealed in brass. Throw it: the flask bursts and keeps frostbite off everyone within four blocks for a minute.

cutscene.frozen_dominion.turnkey.say_fig: You have opened the door. Now face what lies beyond.

cutscene.frozen_dominion.lamplighter.say: Let the darkness consume what remains of you.

cutscene.frozen_dominion.drowned_lady.sa: Breathe deeply. This will be your last breath.

Witness the power of true devotion.
